Edit image 1. It is a photo of the client's own room, and the result must still be that same room, exactly: the same camera position, angle, lens and framing; the same walls, ceiling, floor, light fixture and outlets; the same windows, with the same frames, in the same places. Do not add, remove, move or enlarge any wall, window, door or opening, do not extend, rotate or crop the room, and do not change its light. Wherever no new furniture goes, the result is image 1 unchanged.

Images 2 to 7 are the products to add, one photo each:
image 2: three-seat sofa with rolled arms, size unknown
image 3: wingback accent chair, 94 cm wide, 74 cm deep, 103 cm high, 2 units
image 4: large medallion wool rug, 292 cm wide, 231 cm deep, 2 cm high
image 5: X-base wood coffee table, 120 cm wide, 60 cm deep, 46 cm high
image 6: rectangular overlay wall mirror, 102 cm wide, 76 cm deep, 2 cm high
image 7: turned-column floor lamp, 43 cm wide, 43 cm deep, 154 cm high

Add exactly these products and nothing else: no other furniture, lamps, plants, rugs or decoration than these (books on the shelves of a bookcase are fine). Each one must be the product of its photo, not a similar one: the same design, proportions, colors and materials. A product listed with "2 units" goes twice.

The client asked: "Una sala antigua con molduras y chimenea. Quiero un living clásico y elegante alrededor de la chimenea: un sofá tapizado en terciopelo verde oscuro, dos sillones enfrentados, una mesa ratona de madera oscura, una alfombra grande de diseño tradicional, una lámpara de pie con pantalla de tela y un espejo grande con marco sobre la chimenea.". Arrange the products as an interior designer would for that, against the walls and on the floor that image 1 shows, each at its real size for this room, lit by this room's light. The result must look like a real photograph of image 1's room.
